trigger.description: Work a ticket (W-NNNN) in the acme-billing repository end to end. Use when a prompt names a work item or asks to change billing, customer or schema code.

steps.title: Read the work item
steps.text: **Read the work item.** Run `scripts/wi-lookup <ID>` (for example `scripts/wi-lookup W-2042`). It prints the title, description, linked files and acceptance criteria. Read the linked files first; you rarely need to explore beyond them.

steps.title: If the item adds or changes a record field
steps.text: **If the item adds or changes a record field**, edit the schema in `schema/<record>.json`, never `acme/generated/models.py` (it is generated). After editing `schema/*.json`, run `make gen` to regenerate `acme/generated/models.py`.

steps.title: Make the code change
steps.text: **Make the code change** in the linked files under `acme/`.
steps.why_not: no command: the step is the agent's judgment (an edit or a decision)

steps.title: Run the tests with `make test`
steps.text: **Run the tests with `make test`.** Never run `python3 -m unittest` or `pytest` directly instead of `make test`: `tests/__init__.py` refuses to run without `ACME_ENV` and fails with `RuntimeError: ACME_ENV is not set`, and pytest is not installed. Expect `OK` at the end.

steps.title: Before you finish, run `make ci`
steps.text: **Before you finish, run `make ci`.** It checks that the generated models are fresh and runs the whole suite. It fails with `generated models are stale` if you skipped `make gen`.

advice: Work items live only in the internal tracker; a prompt usually names just the id, such as W-2042.
- Keep changes minimal and inside the linked files. - Do not commit; leave the working tree for review.
